entries.1fdb515ab8fd3a37: At HOUSE OF ROSE directly operated stores, the company sells its own-brand skincare cosmetics and other products through its "Hand Wash" experience and "Fureru (touch)" customer service.
entries.217f0969e9da5f12: HOUSE OF ROSE’s directly operated stores state that, through a sales method called “hand washing,” in which facial cleansers and similar products are used while the customer's hands are touched to explain face-washing methods, they are further strengthening “touch-based service” as the company's strength, and working to improve performance through increased sales of skincare cosmetics.

entries.333acd87cec85ef0: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,541 million, of which the directly operated store product sales business accounted for ¥8,957 million.
entries.33a44b86d65a839a: This is a cosmetics wholesale business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,376 million. It consists of wholesale to individually owned stores, wholesale to major mass retailers, and general wholesale including cross-border EC to China.

entries.4fa9d3d4962c825e: Under its management philosophy, “To provide superior products and heartfelt service to people who wish for beauty, health and a comfortable life,” the company says that in its directly operated store product sales and wholesale businesses it focuses on developing stores and products that many customers support, aims to expand contact with new customers for stable sales growth, and in its directly operated store service business intends to offer a place for a “health”-oriented lifestyle and “fureai” (human connection).
entries.57cc015b5dd96123: It operates British-style reflexology salons and other facilities.

The company group consists of the company, 4 subsidiaries and 1 other affiliate, and the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 752.

The structure also envisions strengthening the customer base, including integrating the membership systems of directly operated stores and the EC business.
